abstract: Configure LlamaIndex (Python llama-index 0.14.x) against self-hosted OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints: vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LiteLLM and llama-swap. Covers OpenAILike, Anthropic, Ollama and OpenAILikeEmbedding, capability flags and context windows, Settings defaults that fall back to OpenAI, key handling without printing secrets, model names, structured_predict program modes, FunctionAgent tool calling, streaming usage, troubleshooting, and a curl and jq probe script.
